visual_action: The video consists of a slideshow of two still images. The first is of Donald Trump on a golf course, wearing a red 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat. The second is of Joe Biden, smiling and wearing sunglasses and a suit, outdoors on a lawn.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in the first still image and is mentioned in the on-screen text on the second image: 'He's the only person that's ever beat Trump'.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is shown in the second still image. The text overlays position him as the protagonist against Trump.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the @democrats account.

on_screen_text.text: He said he's going to be a dictator on day one.
He's the only person that's ever beat Trump

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: An upbeat, rhythmic instrumental track with a driving beat plays consistently throughout the video, creating a confident and hype-filled tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow, cutting from one still image to another.
central_claim: Joe Biden is the only person who has proven he can defeat the dictatorial threat posed by Donald Trump.
intended_effect: To create alarm about Donald Trump while building confidence in Joe Biden as the necessary choice to stop him.
